metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Pip Ringgnaw
records.biography_en: In The Tiny Splats, Pip Ringgnaw takes the role of determined teether. “It has to fit.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: large smooth sage teething ring held to mouth.

records.name: Mina Bottlecloud
records.biography_en: In The Tiny Splats, Mina Bottlecloud takes the role of astonished bottle holder. “There is more in there.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small smooth milk bottle, wide cap and visible milk line.

records.name: Bert Firstwobble
records.biography_en: In The Tiny Splats, Bert Firstwobble takes the role of proud first wobbler. “I meant to do that.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one oversized nesting cup held out, romper wrap.

records.name: Ned Softhush
records.biography_en: In The Tiny Splats, Ned Softhush takes the role of sleepy blanket clutcher. “Wake me after the nap.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small folded blanket held against one cheek.

records.name: Tess Blockrule
records.biography_en: In The Tiny Splats, Tess Blockrule takes the role of serious block stacker. “The small one goes first.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two chunky rounded toy blocks pressed together.

records.name: Gus Ducksqueak
records.biography_en: In The Tiny Splats, Gus Ducksqueak takes the role of startled bath toy owner. “It said something.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small smooth yellow rubber duck held in both hands, cozy pastel towel wrap.
